name: LiteRouter
description: LiteRouter's free Basic plan includes selected free models and daily premium requests.
overview: LiteRouter's $0 Basic plan advertises unlimited requests per day for some free models and up to 50 premium model requests per day. Free calls have a seven-second cooldown and the plan allows one concurrent request, so unlimited does not mean unrestricted throughput. The official quickstart uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and deepseek-v3.2:free.

offer.label: Free Basic plan with daily usage

free_access: $0 Basic plan with selected free models
Up to 50 premium model requests per day
One concurrent request and seven-second cooldown
notes: Card requirement at signup was not confirmed. The free model selection and premium quota are subject to provider limits; the Basic plan does not promise every free model is unlimited.
